Kazook.name: Kazook
Kazook.summary: Kazook is a budget-priced mini-game collection for the PSP that only got a release in Europe and Australia.

Kirameki School Life SP - The Wonder Yea.name: Kirameki School Life SP: The Wonder Years
Kirameki School Life SP - The Wonder Yea.summary: Kirameki School Life SP: The Wonder Years is a romance visual novel developed by guyzware and published by Banpresto. It represents a certain game that appears in the original story of the Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai series and was only released in the limited edition of Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai Portable.

Summon Night 4.name: Summon Night 4
Summon Night 4.summary: Summon Night 4 is a Japanese tactical RPG and the last entry in the Summon Night series developed by Flight Plan. The plot in this game focus on a parent/child relationship.
